source.title: Procedurally synthesized SFX one-shots and weather layers (footsteps, weapons, doors, fire, weather, water, paper, UI, coins)
source.pageText: Generated in-repository by scripts/tools/synth_sfx.py with seeded numpy DSP; no third-party recordings involved.

evidenceNotes: policy: project-original — exempt from third-party license tiers; governed by the project license.
Deterministic synthesis (fixed per-variant seeds); regenerable byte-for-byte via scripts/tools/synth_sfx.py.
Deliberately excludes music, crowd/voice ambience, and signature sounds (sympathy, Naming, Chandrian, lute performances) which require human review or recorded sources.
